examples.text: Getting a flu shot is a good safeguard against illness.

A player playing a position named guard.

examples.text: When an engineer wished to stop a swiftly moving train he had first to whistle to the guard requesting him to apply the hand-brake of the van, and then apply the hand-brake of the engine. Guards did not always hear.
